properties.content:

Nearest City: Galva, IA
Incident Type: CONTINUOUS
Material: AMMONIA, ANHYDROUS
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: AIR LIQUIDE INDUSTRIAL US L.P.
Skytruth Analysis
ON APR 24,2008 THE AMMONIA CONDENSER WAS SHUT DOWN DUE TO AN ODOR THAT WAS DETECTED IN A ROUTINE INVESTIGATION. THE SOURCE OF THE LEAK WAS IDENTIFIED AND BLOCKED AND THAT COIL WAS TAKEN OUT OF SERVICE. BASED ON PRELIMINARY CALCULATIONS THE LEAK WAS BELOW 89 LBS WITHIN A 24 HOUR PERIOD AND THE REMAINING COIL WAS RESTARTED. IN AN AUDIT OF THE AMMONIA CONDENSER ON JULY 1,2008 IT WAS DETERMINED THAT THE AMOUNT OF THE PAST AMMONIA RELEASE MAY HAVE TOTALED 443 POUNDS PER DAY. THE UNIT WAS ALREADY SHUT DOWN FOR MAINTENANCE WHEN THE REVISED EMISSION AMOUNTS WERE DISCOVERED. THE REMAINING COIL WAS ISOLATED AND THE AMMONIA WAS EVACUATED FROM THE SYSTEM.
